name: Company launch
tagline: Incorporate, get the EIN, open the bank account, turn on payroll and the books.

name: First hire
tagline: Offer out and signed, payroll running, accounts provisioned.

name: Month-end close
tagline: Reconcile and close the books, pay what's due, know the runway.

name: Get paid
tagline: Connect payments, stand up subscriptions, send the invoice, reconcile the payout.

name: Launch the website
tagline: Domain checked and bought, site generated, DNS wired, analytics on.

name: Raise a seed round
tagline: Data room standing, SAFEs signed, wires verified, cap table made true.

name: Get the first 10 customers
tagline: CRM up, outbound out, calls qualified, the first invoices sent.

name: Launch on Product Hunt
tagline: Assets ready, submitted to PH and the directories, the signup spike measured and captured.

name: Set up compliance (SOC 2-lite)
tagline: Password manager, SSO, privacy policy and DPA, then the SOC 2 Type I run.

name: Ship v1
tagline: Repo to CI to cloud to observability — the product stack stood up end to end.

name: Raise the follow-on round
tagline: Fresh data room and 409A, the priced round closed, the cap table current.
